Name: Cobalt (ABANDONED)
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[color=Red][b][size=5]This mod is no longer maintained and may not work in newer game versions.[/size][/b][/color]
See the [url=https://smapi.io/mods/#Cobalt]compatibility list[/url] for possible alternatives.


[s]Adds a new tier of tools and a sprinkler.

Cobalt bars are crafted with iridium ingots and a prismatic shard.

The cobalt bar recipe appears shortly after you have an iridium tool.

The cobalt sprinkler recipe appears while there is an iridium sprinkler in your inventory, and you know the cobalt bar recipe.[/s]

Downloads.Description:
Change from CEH to PyTK.
Fix sprinklers sprinkling at (0,0) after the first day.
Added API (used by DataMaps).
